records.failureSummary: Reviewed slice-4 (FR-3 create + FR-4 list/search) for AC coverage and 5xx risk. Result: NOT APPROVED because project-wide pnpm test is NOT green. node --test full suite = 145 tests, 144 passed, 1 failed, 0 errors; the single failure is FR-9.6 [AC-30] in test/contract.test.js:189, which asserts every test title carries an FR-x.y/AC-xx identifier and is tripped by two top-level titles inside THIS slice own file: test/task-create.test.js:491 ('regression POST /api/tasks rejects undefined body fields with 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD') and :515 ('regression POST /api/tasks without a valid Bearer token returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED'). So the criterion 'run pnpm test, whole slice green, names parse out AC-14..AC-18 and AC-23' is only half met. All six required identifiers DO resolve in current titles: AC-14 (task-create:289), AC-15 (:323), AC-16 (:385), AC-17 (:419), AC-18 (:452), AC-23 (four top-level tests in ta[REDACTED].test.js:302/393/462/497). Both slice files are green in isolation: task-create 31/31 and ta[REDACTED] 33/33 (combined node --test --test-reporter=dot exit 0, 64 subtests). Boundary coverage is complete: AC-15 has 3 subtests (exactly-100 accepted, 101 rejected 400 TITLE_INVALID, padded-100 trimmed accepted); AC-16 has 3 (trim '  Alpha  ' -> 'Alpha', spaces-only rejected, tabs/newlines-all-whitespace rejected); AC-17 has 2 (CJK+emoji round-trip, ZWJ emoji round-trip, no U+FFFD); AC-18 has 8 (2026-02-30, 2026-13-01, 2026-2-3, 2026/02/28, 2025-02-29, 2026-04-31 rejected; 2026-02-28, 2024-02-29 accepted). Malicious q probing is covered by the green AC-23 fuzz test (16 hostile raw query strings: double/single quote, semicolon, SQL fragment, SQL keyword fragment, encoded+raw percent, malformed %E0%A4%A, lone %, emoji, CJK, regex metachars, NUL/control chars, 5000-char, empty value, bare q) each asserted status < 500 and, when 200, a caller-only items envelope with no cross-user title leakage. Implementation corroborates: src/http/taskListHandler.js decodes q tolerantly (decodeURIComponent with raw-literal fallback on URIError, '+' as space), filters with title.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()) (never RegExp/SQL), scopes ownership only from ctx.userId, projects via toPublicTask, and wraps parse/filter/serialize in try/catch. No CI, staging/production deployment or delivery-chain task exists: no .github, no workflow, no Dockerfile/compose/deploy script in the tree (the token Dockerfile appears only as a documented README command required by FR-9.4). Blocking item remains the AC-30 naming regression on the two slice-authored regression titles.
